title: 第十九章 巅峰反杀第二十章 凡尘遇雨天各一方
content_zh:
周渊立在街心，灰袍无风自动。
筑基巅峰的气息彻底铺开，压得整条街道的砖石都微微发颤。
那种压迫感，和李奎、楚浩完全是两个概念。
数十年苦修沉淀，灵气浑厚如海、凝练如铁，每一缕气息都带着久经杀伐的冰冷杀意。
在南疆低阶修士的世界里，筑基巅峰，已经是凡人所能触及的武道尽头。
他垂着眼，居高临下地打量门前的烬孤宸，眼神里没有重视，只有一种看蝼蚁的漠然。
“小小年纪，有一身罕见的完美筑基，确实难得。”
周渊声音低沉，像磨过砂的铁器，冷硬刺骨。
“可惜，不知安分，不懂敬畏。”
“好好的一介散修天才，非要跑来我青岚宗地界撒野，废我门人、辱我宗威。”
“天资再好，心性狂妄，终究是夭折的命。”
在他眼里，这少年已经是个死人。
完美筑基确实罕见，越级战力也确实惊人。
但越级，有极限。
筑基初期，再妖孽，也不可能跨过三个小境界，撼动他这尊筑基巅峰的老牌长老。
一旁趴在地上的楚浩，死死攥紧拳头，眼底满是疯狂快意。
终于。
终于轮到周长老出手了。
刚才他承受的所有屈辱、伤痛、碾压，今日必将百倍、千倍还给这个布衣少年！
四周所有围观的镇民、散修，全部屏住呼吸，心脏悬到了极致。

没人觉得烬孤宸能赢。
差距太大，大到令人绝望。
就像涓涓细流对抗汪洋大海，初生稚虎直面成年巨熊。
这一战，从一开始，结局就注定了。
面对周渊的俯视与定论，烬孤宸静静站在门槛前，神色依旧平稳。
没有紧绷，没有凝重，更没有丝毫慌乱。
他只是看着对方，轻声开口：
“你们青岚宗，从上到下。”
“弟子蛮横，执事霸道，长老不讲理。”
“从头到尾，是你们一次次逼人出手。”
“如今输不起，搬出辈分、修为、势力来压人。”
“这就是你们百年宗门的风骨？”
几句话，直白锋利，狠狠戳破周渊虚伪的定论。
周渊眼神瞬间一冷。
“牙尖嘴利。”
“临死之前，我让你多说两句。”
话音未落，他身形骤然一动。
没有多余起手，没有招式铺垫。
身为筑基巅峰强者，他的战斗早已返璞归真。
最简单、最直接、最霸道的近身碾压。

脚下空气猛地炸开，身影瞬间掠出十丈距离，快到肉眼几乎无法捕捉。
一掌横推而出。
掌风厚重如山，灵气凝练成实质，覆盖整片街面，封锁所有闪避空间。
content_en:
Zhou Yuan stood in the middle of the street, his gray robe moving without any wind.
The aura of the peak of foundation building spread out completely, causing the bricks and stones of the entire street to tremble slightly.
That sense of oppression is completely different from Li Kui and Chu Hao.
After decades of hard training, his spiritual energy is as thick as the sea and as condensed as iron. Every breath carries the cold murderous intention that has been destroyed for a long time.
In the world of low-level monks in Southern Xinjiang, the peak of foundation building is already the end of martial arts that mortals can reach.
He lowered his eyes and looked down at Jin Guchen in front of the door. There was no attention in his eyes, only the indifference of looking at an ant.
"It is indeed rare to have a rare and perfect foundation at such a young age."
Zhou Yuan's voice was low, like polished iron, cold and biting.
"It's a pity that I don't know how to be safe and reverent."
"A good casual cultivator has to come to our Qinglan Sect and run wild, destroying our disciples and humiliating our sect's prestige."
"No matter how talented you are, if you are arrogant, you will eventually die young."
In his eyes, this young man was already a dead man.
Perfect foundation building is indeed rare, and the level-leap combat power is indeed amazing.
But there are limits to leapfrogging.
In the early stage of foundation building, no matter how evil you are, it is impossible to cross the three small realms and shake him, a veteran elder who is at the peak of foundation building.
Chu Hao, who was lying on the ground beside him, clenched his fists tightly, his eyes filled with crazy joy.
finally.
Finally it was Elder Zhou's turn to take action.
All the humiliation, pain, and crushing he endured just now will be returned to this commoner boy a hundred or a thousand times today!
All the surrounding townspeople and casual cultivators who were watching held their breaths, their hearts racing to the extreme.
No one thought Jin Guchen could win.
The gap is so huge that it is despairing.
Just like a trickle of water against the vast ocean, a newborn tiger faces an adult giant bear.
The outcome of this battle was doomed from the beginning.
Facing Zhou Yuan's overlooking look and conclusion, Jin Guchen stood quietly in front of the threshold, his expression still calm.
There was no tension, no solemnity, and no trace of panic.
He just looked at the other person and spoke softly:
"Your Qinglan Sect, from top to bottom."
"The disciples are arrogant, the deacons are overbearing, and the elders are unreasonable."
"From the beginning to the end, it was you who forced people to take action again and again."
"Now that I can't afford to lose, I use seniority, cultivation, and power to suppress others."
"Is this the character of your century-old sect?"
A few words, straightforward and sharp, severely exposed Zhou Yuan's hypocritical conclusion.
Zhou Yuan's eyes turned cold instantly.
"Sharp teeth and sharp mouth."
"Before you die, I want you to say a few more words."
Before he finished speaking, his figure suddenly moved.
There are no extra starting hands and no foreshadowing of moves.
As a peak-level foundation-building expert, his fighting skills have long since returned to his original state.
The simplest, most direct, and most domineering close-quarters crushing.
The air beneath his feet suddenly exploded, and his figure instantly flew ten feet away, so fast that it was almost impossible to catch it with the naked eye.
Pushed out with a palm.
The palm wind is as thick as a mountain, and the spiritual energy is condensed into substance, covering the entire street and blocking all evasive spaces.
